newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS EDGE UP, MOGAS ASKS AROUND $217.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS EDGE UP, MOGAS ASKS AROUND $217.

text.p: European oil products mostly edged higher on Tuesday morning after a mixed start to trading.
Gasoline barges were steady asking $216 fob ARA or $218 for running refinery production. Swaps nudged up from opening level to around $209 for August and $193 for September.
Gas oil was up $1 a tonne on the IPE at $169.00 for August but premiums for physical barges were unchanged at 75 cents above the screen.
Heavy fuel barges were steady after climbing $1 a tonne soon after the open.
